---- MODULE W4Od13m8p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Machines == {"m1", "m2"}
NONE == "none"
Total == 2

VARIABLES coarse, fine, coins, bank, transit, crashed

vars == <<coarse, fine, coins, bank, transit, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = [m \in Machines |-> NONE]
    /\ coins = [m \in Machines |-> 1]
    /\ bank = 0
    /\ transit = 0
    /\ crashed = {}

AcquireCoarse(m) ==
    /\ m \notin crashed
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = m
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, coins, bank, transit, crashed>>

AcquireFine(m) ==
    /\ m \notin crashed
    /\ coarse = m
    /\ fine[m] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![m] = m]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, coins, bank, transit, crashed>>

BeginMove(m) ==
    /\ m \notin crashed
    /\ coarse = m
    /\ fine[m] = m
    /\ coins[m] > 0
    /\ coins' = [coins EXCEPT ![m] = @ - 1]
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, bank, crashed>>

Deposit(m) ==
    /\ m \notin crashed
    /\ coarse = m
    /\ fine[m] = m
    /\ transit > 0
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ bank' = bank + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, coins, crashed>>

Release(m) ==
    /\ coarse = m
    /\ transit = 0
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![m] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coins, bank, transit, crashed>>

Crash(m) ==
    /\ m \notin crashed
    /\ coarse # m
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, coins, bank, transit>>

Idle ==
    /\ crashed # {}
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines : AcquireCoarse(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : AcquireFine(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : BeginMove(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Deposit(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Release(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Crash(m)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conserved ==
    bank + transit + (coins["m1"] + coins["m2"]) = Total
====
nl:
A network of vending machines each holds coins. A central bank accumulates coins swept from
machines. To move a coin, a machine must first acquire the network-wide coarse lock, then the
per-machine fine lock (hierarchical, coarse before fine). It then removes one coin from itself
into an in-transit buffer, and later deposits the in-transit coin into the bank. Locks are
released together. Any machine may crash silently at any moment it does not hold the coarse
lock; a crashed machine takes no further steps but its coins remain in place. Once at least one
machine has crashed, the network may simply idle, waiting without changing anything. No coin is
ever created or destroyed by acquiring locks, moving, depositing, releasing, crashing, or idling.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of coins across all machines, the in-transit buffer, and the bank is always exactly the initial total.

EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Runways == {"r1", "r2"}
Parts == {"a1", "a2"}
NONE == "none"
Cap == 1

VARIABLES phase, prop, votes, occ, crashed

vars == <<phase, prop, votes, occ, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ prop = NONE
    /\ votes = [a \in Parts |-> NONE]
    /\ occ = [r \in Runways |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

Propose(r) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ prop' = r
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [a \in Parts |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, crashed>>

Vote(a, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ a \notin crashed
    /\ votes[a] = NONE
    /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![a] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, prop, occ, crashed>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A a \in Parts : votes[a] = "yes"
    /\ occ[prop] < Cap
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![prop] = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prop, votes, crashed>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \/ \E a \in Parts : votes[a] = "no"
       \/ \E a \in Parts : (a \in crashed /\ votes[a] = NONE)
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prop, votes, occ, crashed>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ prop' = NONE
    /\ votes' = [a \in Parts |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, crashed>>

Release(r) ==
    /\ occ[r] > 0
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![r] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, prop, votes, crashed>>

Crash(a) ==
    /\ a \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {a}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, prop, votes, occ>>

Idle ==
    /\ crashed # {}
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Runways : Propose(r)
    \/ \E a \in Parts, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(a, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Reset
    \/ \E r \in Runways : Release(r)
    \/ \E a \in Parts : Crash(a)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapOK == \A r \in Runways : occ[r] <= Cap
====
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator assigns arriving aircraft to runways using two-phase commit.
Each runway has a fixed capacity of one aircraft. A coordinator proposes assigning an aircraft
to a runway; two safety-check participants then vote yes or no. The assignment commits only if
both participants vote yes and the chosen runway is still below capacity, at which point the
runway's occupancy increases by one. If any participant votes no, or a participant has crashed
silently and cannot vote, the round aborts. A committed or aborted round resets to idle. An
occupied runway may release its aircraft when it departs. Any participant may crash silently; a
crashed participant never votes again, and once one has crashed the allocator may idle.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No runway ever holds more aircraft than its capacity of one.

EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Procs == {"p1", "p2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES reg, status, open, crashed

vars == <<reg, status, open, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ reg = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ status = [p \in Procs |-> [s \in Slots |-> "idle"]]
    /\ open = [s \in Slots |-> TRUE]
    /\ crashed = {}

Try(p, s) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ status[p][s] = "idle"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![p][s] = "trying"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, open, crashed>>

Enter(p, s) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ status[p][s] = "trying"
    /\ open[s]
    /\ reg[s] = NONE
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![p][s] = "cs"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<open, crashed>>

Exit(p, s) ==
    /\ status[p][s] = "cs"
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![p][s] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<open, crashed>>

Close(s) ==
    /\ open[s]
    /\ open' = [open EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, status, crashed>>

OpenUp(s) ==
    /\ ~ open[s]
    /\ open' = [open EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, status, crashed>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, status, open>>

Idle ==
    /\ crashed # {}
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Procs, s \in Slots : Try(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Procs, s \in Slots : Enter(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Procs, s \in Slots : Exit(p, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Close(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : OpenUp(s)
    \/ \E p \in Procs : Crash(p)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutexHolds == \A p \in Procs, s \in Slots : (status[p][s] = "cs") => (reg[s] = p)
====
nl:
A network of vending machines coordinates exclusive access to shared dispensing slots. Each slot
has a compare-and-swap register naming its current holder, or none. A process wanting a slot first
marks itself trying, then enters the slot only by compare-and-swapping the register from none to
itself, which is allowed only while the slot is open for service. On exit it clears the register
and returns to idle. An operator may close a slot for maintenance (blocking new entries) and later
reopen it. Any process may crash silently at any time and then takes no further steps; once some
process has crashed the network may idle. Entry through the register is the only way a process
occupies a slot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a process occupies a slot, that slot's register names exactly that process.

---- MODULE W4Od9m5p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Controllers == {"c1", "c2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
Voters == {"v1", "v2", "v3"}
NONE == "none"
Quorum == 2

VARIABLES owner, state, want, votes

vars == <<owner, state, want, votes>>

TallyOf(c) == Cardinality({m \in votes : m.c = c /\ m.s = want[c]})

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ state = [c \in Controllers |-> "idle"]
    /\ want = [c \in Controllers |-> NONE]
    /\ votes = {}

Request(c, s) ==
    /\ state[c] = "idle"
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![c] = "requesting"]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![c] = s]
    /\ votes' = {m \in votes : m.c # c}
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Vote(c, vt) ==
    /\ state[c] = "requesting"
    /\ ~ \E m \in votes : m.c = c /\ m.voter = vt
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {[c |-> c, s |-> want[c], voter |-> vt]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, state, want>>

Commit(c) ==
    /\ state[c] = "requesting"
    /\ TallyOf(c) >= Quorum
    /\ owner[want[c]] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![want[c]] = c]
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![c] = "committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<want, votes>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ state[c] = "committed"
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![want[c]] = NONE]
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ votes' = {m \in votes : m.c # c}

Cancel(c) ==
    /\ state[c] = "requesting"
    /\ owner[want[c]] # NONE
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ votes' = {m \in votes : m.c # c}
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, s \in Slots : Request(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, vt \in Voters : Vote(c, vt)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Commit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Release(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Cancel(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OwnerAgrees == \A c \in Controllers : (state[c] = "committed") => (owner[want[c]] = c)
====
nl:
A power-grid load shedder allocates shedding slots to regional controllers by quorum voting.
A controller requests a slot, then a set of three voters each cast a vote for that request;
votes are messages that may arrive and be counted in any order. When at least two votes (a
quorum) for the same controller-and-slot have accumulated, the controller commits the allocation,
but only if the slot's owner register is currently free, at which point the register records that
controller as the slot's owner. A committed controller may later release its slot, freeing the
register. A requesting controller whose desired slot has already been taken may cancel back to
idle. Committing is the only way a slot's register comes to name a controller.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any controller that has committed a slot is the sole owner recorded in that slot's register.

    /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, instEpoch>>

    /\ instEpoch' = [instEpoch EXCEPT ![i] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, cap, epoch>>

    /\ instEpoch[i] = epoch
    /\ enrolled < cap
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, epoch, instEpoch>>

    /\ enrolled' = enrolled - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, epoch, instEpoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E nc \in Caps : Reconfigure(nc)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : SyncEpoch(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Enroll(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Drop(i)

====
nl:
A course-registration system runs two independent registrar instances that both enroll students
into a single shared seat pool for one course. The course has a current capacity and an epoch
number. An administrator may reconfigure the course, which increments the epoch and sets a new
capacity, but never a capacity below the number already enrolled. Each instance caches the epoch
it last synced; before enrolling it must sync to the current epoch. An instance enrolls one
student only while the shared pool is below capacity. Any instance may drop a student, freeing a
seat. Both instances act on the same shared enrollment count.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of enrolled students never exceeds the course's current capacity.

    /\ target = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]

    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![i] = c]

    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![target[i]] = i]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "fine"]

    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "cs"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, target>>

    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![DeptOf(target[i])] = NONE]
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![target[i]] = NONE]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]

A course-registration system lets two independent registrar instances edit shared course records.
Records are protected by hierarchical locks: to edit a course an instance must first take the
coarse lock on the course's department, then the fine lock on the specific course, always coarse
before fine. Only after holding both may it enter the editing critical section. On finishing it
releases the fine lock and the coarse lock together and returns to idle. Both instances contend
for the same shared department and course locks.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever an instance is editing a course, it holds both that course's fine lock and its department's coarse lock.

---- MODULE W4Od5m2p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Groups == {"g1", "g2"}
Lobbies == {"L1", "L2"}
Parts == {"a1", "a2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES occ, phase, prop, votes, seated, slow

vars == <<occ, phase, prop, votes, seated, slow>>

Init ==
    /\ occ = [L \in Lobbies |-> NONE]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ prop = [g |-> NONE, L |-> NONE]
    /\ votes = [a \in Parts |-> NONE]
    /\ seated = [g \in Groups |-> NONE]
    /\ slow = {}

Propose(g, L) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ seated[g] = NONE
    /\ prop' = [g |-> g, L |-> L]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [a \in Parts |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, seated, slow>>

MarkSlow(a) ==
    /\ a \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {a}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, phase, prop, votes, seated>>

CatchUp(a) ==
    /\ a \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {a}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, phase, prop, votes, seated>>

Vote(a, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ a \notin slow
    /\ votes[a] = NONE
    /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![a] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, phase, prop, seated, slow>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A a \in Parts : votes[a] = "yes"
    /\ occ[prop.L] = NONE
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![prop.L] = prop.g]
    /\ seated' = [seated EXCEPT ![prop.g] = prop.L]
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prop, votes, slow>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E a \in Parts : votes[a] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, prop, votes, seated, slow>>

ResetRound ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ prop' = [g |-> NONE, L |-> NONE]
    /\ votes' = [a \in Parts |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, seated, slow>>

Leave(g) ==
    /\ seated[g] # NONE
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![seated[g]] = NONE]
    /\ seated' = [seated EXCEPT ![g] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, prop, votes, slow>>

Next ==
    \/ \E g \in Groups, L \in Lobbies : Propose(g, L)
    \/ \E a \in Parts : MarkSlow(a)
    \/ \E a \in Parts : CatchUp(a)
    \/ \E a \in Parts, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(a, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ ResetRound
    \/ \E g \in Groups : Leave(g)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SeatAgrees == \A g \in Groups : (seated[g] # NONE) => (occ[seated[g]] = g)
====
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker seats groups of players into lobbies using two-phase commit.
A coordinator proposes seating a group into a lobby; two anti-cheat participants must each vote
yes. A participant may be slow: while marked slow it cannot vote yet, but it is never failed and
may catch up, after which it votes normally. The seating commits only when both participants have
voted yes and the target lobby is unoccupied, recording the group as the lobby's occupant and
marking the group seated. If any participant votes no the round aborts. Committed or aborted
rounds reset to idle, and a seated group may later leave its lobby, freeing it.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any group marked seated in a lobby is the group recorded as that lobby's occupant.

---- MODULE W4Od0m9p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Schedulers == {"s1", "s2"}
Tokens == {"t1", "t2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES record, acked, epoch, schedEpoch, capacity, pending

vars == <<record, acked, epoch, schedEpoch, capacity, pending>>

Init ==
    /\ record = {}
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ schedEpoch = [s \in Schedulers |-> 0]
    /\ capacity = 2
    /\ pending = [s \in Schedulers |-> NONE]

Reconfigure(nc) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ nc \in {1, 2}
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ capacity' = nc
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, schedEpoch, pending>>

SyncEpoch(s) ==
    /\ schedEpoch[s] # epoch
    /\ schedEpoch' = [schedEpoch EXCEPT ![s] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, epoch, capacity, pending>>

Propose(s, t) ==
    /\ pending[s] = NONE
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![s] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, epoch, schedEpoch, capacity>>

Commit(s) ==
    /\ pending[s] # NONE
    /\ schedEpoch[s] = epoch
    /\ pending[s] \notin record
    /\ Cardinality(record) < capacity
    /\ record' = record \cup {pending[s]}
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<acked, epoch, schedEpoch, capacity>>

Ack(t) ==
    /\ t \in record
    /\ t \notin acked
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, epoch, schedEpoch, capacity, pending>>

Cancel(t) ==
    /\ t \in record
    /\ record' = record \ {t}
    /\ acked' = acked \ {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, schedEpoch, capacity, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E nc \in {1, 2} : Reconfigure(nc)
    \/ \E s \in Schedulers : SyncEpoch(s)
    \/ \E s \in Schedulers, t \in Tokens : Propose(s, t)
    \/ \E s \in Schedulers : Commit(s)
    \/ \E t \in Tokens : Ack(t)
    \/ \E t \in Tokens : Cancel(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate == acked \subseteq record
====
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler keeps a shared record of confirmed surgery bookings. Two
schedulers add bookings. The configuration carries an epoch and a capacity that can change at
runtime: an administrator may reconfigure, incrementing the epoch and setting a new room
capacity. A scheduler caches an epoch and must sync to the current epoch before committing. A
scheduler first proposes a booking token, then commits it into the shared record only while at
the current epoch and while the record is below capacity; commits accumulate, never overwriting
existing bookings. A booking may be acknowledged to the client only once it is present in the
record. A booking may be cancelled, which removes it from both the record and the acknowledged set.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every acknowledged booking is still present in the shared record.

    \/ \E p \in Parts : Release(p)
    \/ \E p \in Parts : Crash(p)

nl:
A stock exchange opening auction prints an opening price for each symbol exactly once. Printing is
guarded by hierarchical locks: a participant must first take the exchange-wide coarse lock, then a
symbol's fine lock, always coarse before fine. Holding both, it may print the symbol's opening
price, which is irreversible: each symbol has a single print permit, and printing consumes that
permit and marks the symbol printed. A participant may release, dropping its coarse lock and any
fine locks it holds. Any participant may crash silently while not holding the coarse lock and
thereafter takes no steps; once some participant has crashed the auction may idle. Because the
permit is consumed on printing, a symbol can never be printed twice.
SAFETY PROPERTY: If a symbol's opening price has been printed, that symbol's print permit has been consumed.

Dispense(n) ==

    /\ alive[n]
    /\ dispensed < Cap

Restock ==

    /\ dispensed' = dispensed - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, alive, adminMode>>

    /\ adminMode
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, dispensed, adminMode>>

    /\ adminMode' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, alive, dispensed>>

ClearAdmin ==
    /\ adminMode
    /\ adminMode' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, alive, dispensed>>

    \/ FailLeader
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)

A vending machine network elects a leader node that authorizes dispensing from a shared stock with
a fixed capacity. A node may be elected leader when there is no leader, bumping the term. The
leader may fail over: it goes offline and the leadership is vacated. A failed node may recover and
come back online. The current leader, while online, may dispense one item as long as the amount
dispensed is below capacity; items may also be restocked, decreasing the dispensed amount. A
privileged admin override may be enabled or cleared; while enabled, an admin may appoint any
online node as leader regardless of the normal election rule, also bumping the term.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The amount dispensed never exceeds the fixed stock capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od1m6p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Instances == {"i1", "i2"}
Runways == {"r1", "r2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxTTL == 2

VARIABLES lease, ttl, inCS, want

vars == <<lease, ttl, inCS, want>>

Init ==
    /\ lease = [r \in Runways |-> NONE]
    /\ ttl = [r \in Runways |-> 0]
    /\ inCS = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]
    /\ want = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]

Request(i, r) ==
    /\ inCS[i] = NONE
    /\ want[i] = NONE
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![i] = r]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, inCS>>

Acquire(i) ==
    /\ want[i] # NONE
    /\ lease[want[i]] = NONE
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![want[i]] = i]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![want[i]] = MaxTTL]
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![i] = want[i]]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]

Renew(i) ==
    /\ inCS[i] # NONE
    /\ lease[inCS[i]] = i
    /\ ttl[inCS[i]] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![inCS[i]] = MaxTTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, inCS, want>>

Tick(r) ==
    /\ lease[r] # NONE
    /\ ttl[r] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![r] = ttl[r] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, inCS, want>>

Expire(r) ==
    /\ lease[r] # NONE
    /\ ttl[r] = 0
    /\ inCS' = [i \in Instances |-> IF inCS[i] = r THEN NONE ELSE inCS[i]]
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, want>>

Release(i) ==
    /\ inCS[i] # NONE
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![inCS[i]] = NONE]
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, want>>

Cancel(i) ==
    /\ want[i] # NONE
    /\ lease[want[i]] # NONE
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, inCS>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, r \in Runways : Request(i, r)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Acquire(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Renew(i)
    \/ \E r \in Runways : Tick(r)
    \/ \E r \in Runways : Expire(r)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Release(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Cancel(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutexHolds == \A i \in Instances : (inCS[i] # NONE) => (lease[inCS[i]] = i)
====
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator gives two independent controller instances mutually exclusive use
of shared runways via time-limited leases. A controller first requests a runway, then acquires it
only while its lease is free, taking the lease, setting a time-to-live, and entering the critical
section of using that runway. While using it the controller may renew the lease, resetting the
time-to-live, and the time-to-live may tick down. When it reaches zero the lease expires, freeing
the runway and evicting the controller from the critical section. A controller may release the
runway directly, freeing the lease and leaving the critical section. A controller whose requested
runway is already leased may cancel its request. Both instances contend for the same shared runways.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a controller is using a runway, that runway's lease is held by exactly that controller.

---- MODULE W4Od14m8p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Drones == {"d1", "d2"}
Cells == {"cl1", "cl2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES coarse, fine, phase, target, slow

vars == <<coarse, fine, phase, target, slow>>

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = [c \in Cells |-> NONE]
    /\ phase = [d \in Drones |-> "idle"]
    /\ target = [d \in Drones |-> NONE]
    /\ slow = {}

AcqCoarse(d) ==
    /\ d \notin slow
    /\ phase[d] = "idle"
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = d
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "coarse"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, target, slow>>

AcqFine(d, c) ==
    /\ d \notin slow
    /\ phase[d] = "coarse"
    /\ fine[c] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![c] = d]
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![d] = c]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "fine"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, slow>>

Enter(d) ==
    /\ d \notin slow
    /\ phase[d] = "fine"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "cs"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, target, slow>>

Exit(d) ==
    /\ phase[d] = "cs"
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![target[d]] = NONE]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "idle"]
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![d] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED slow

MarkSlow(d) ==
    /\ d \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, phase, target>>

CatchUp(d) ==
    /\ d \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, phase, target>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : AcqCoarse(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, c \in Cells : AcqFine(d, c)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Enter(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Exit(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : MarkSlow(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : CatchUp(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

    \A d \in Drones :
        (phase[d] = "cs") => (coarse = d /\ fine[target[d]] = d)
====
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm edits shared airspace-cell assignments under hierarchical
locks. To edit a cell a drone must first take the swarm-wide coarse lock, then that cell's fine
lock, always coarse before fine, and only then may it enter the editing critical section. A drone
may be slow: while marked slow it cannot take a lock or enter the critical section, but it is never
failed and may catch up, after which it proceeds normally. On finishing, a drone exits, releasing
its coarse lock and the fine lock on the cell it was editing and returning to idle; exiting is
allowed even while slow.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a drone is editing a cell, it holds both the coarse lock and that cell's fine lock.

A container-ship crane yard circulates a single token around a ring of cranes; only the crane
currently holding the token may request the irreversible sealing of the shipment manifest. The

and may be delivered and applied in any order. Applying a seal request seals the manifest, but
there is exactly one seal permit: applying consumes the permit, and it applies only if the
requesting crane still holds the token at apply time. A stale seal request, whose issuer no longer
holds the token, may be discarded from the pool. Because the single permit is consumed on sealing,
the manifest can never be sealed twice.

---- MODULE W4Od16m2p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Orders == {"o1", "o2"}
Slots == {"sl1", "sl2"}
Checkers == {"chk1", "chk2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES occ, phase, prop, votes, allocOf, slow

vars == <<occ, phase, prop, votes, allocOf, slow>>

Init ==
    /\ occ = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ prop = [ord |-> NONE, slot |-> NONE]
    /\ votes = [c \in Checkers |-> NONE]
    /\ allocOf = [o \in Orders |-> NONE]
    /\ slow = {}

Propose(o, s) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ allocOf[o] = NONE
    /\ prop' = [ord |-> o, slot |-> s]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [c \in Checkers |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, allocOf, slow>>

MarkSlow(c) ==
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, phase, prop, votes, allocOf>>

CatchUp(c) ==
    /\ c \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, phase, prop, votes, allocOf>>

Vote(c, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ votes[c] = NONE
    /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, phase, prop, allocOf, slow>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A c \in Checkers : votes[c] = "yes"
    /\ occ[prop.slot] = NONE
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![prop.slot] = prop.ord]
    /\ allocOf' = [allocOf EXCEPT ![prop.ord] = prop.slot]
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prop, votes, slow>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E c \in Checkers : votes[c] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, prop, votes, allocOf, slow>>

ResetRound ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ prop' = [ord |-> NONE, slot |-> NONE]
    /\ votes' = [c \in Checkers |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, allocOf, slow>>

Release(o) ==
    /\ allocOf[o] # NONE
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![allocOf[o]] = NONE]
    /\ allocOf' = [allocOf EXCEPT ![o] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, prop, votes, slow>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Orders, s \in Slots : Propose(o, s)
    \/ \E c \in Checkers : MarkSlow(c)
    \/ \E c \in Checkers : CatchUp(c)
    \/ \E c \in Checkers, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(c, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ ResetRound
    \/ \E o \in Orders : Release(o)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OccAgrees == \A o \in Orders : (allocOf[o] # NONE) => (occ[allocOf[o]] = o)
====
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser allocates dispensing slots to orders using two-phase commit. A
coordinator proposes allocating a slot to an order; two checker participants must each vote yes. A
checker may be slow: while marked slow it cannot vote yet, but it is never failed and may catch up,
after which it votes normally. The allocation commits only when both checkers have voted yes and
the target slot is still unallocated, recording the slot's occupant as that order and marking the
order allocated to that slot. If either checker votes no the round aborts. A committed or aborted
round resets to idle. An allocated order may be released, freeing its slot and clearing its
allocation.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every order allocated to a slot is the order recorded as that slot's occupant.

Zones == {"z1", "z2"}
Total == 2
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES cars, transit, epoch, instEpoch

vars == <<cars, transit, epoch, instEpoch>>

Init ==
    /\ cars = [z \in Zones |-> IF z = "z1" THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ transit = 0
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ instEpoch = [i \in Instances |-> 0]

SyncEpoch(i) ==
    /\ instEpoch[i] # epoch
    /\ instEpoch' = [instEpoch EXCEPT ![i] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cars, transit, epoch>>

Dispatch(i, z) ==
    /\ instEpoch[i] = epoch
    /\ cars[z] > 0
    /\ cars' = [cars EXCEPT ![z] = cars[z] - 1]
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, instEpoch>>

Arrive(i, z) ==
    /\ instEpoch[i] = epoch
    /\ transit > 0
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ cars' = [cars EXCEPT ![z] = cars[z] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, instEpoch>>

Reconfigure(zf, zt) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ zf # zt
    /\ cars[zf] > 0
    /\ cars' = [cars EXCEPT ![zf] = cars[zf] - 1, ![zt] = cars[zt] + 1]
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<transit, instEpoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : SyncEpoch(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, z \in Zones : Dispatch(i, z)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, z \in Zones : Arrive(i, z)
    \/ \E zf \in Zones, zt \in Zones : Reconfigure(zf, zt)

nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper distributes a fixed fleet of cars across floor zones, managed by
two independent dispatcher instances that share the same fleet. A car may be dispatched from a
zone, moving it out of that zone and into the in-transit pool, and later a car in transit arrives
into some zone; both operations require the acting instance to be at the current epoch. An
administrator may reconfigure the zoning, which rebalances by moving one car directly from one
zone to another and increments the epoch. Each instance caches an epoch and must sync to the
current epoch before dispatching or receiving arrivals. No car is ever created or destroyed by
dispatching, arriving, rebalancing, or syncing.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of cars across all zones plus those in transit always equals the fixed fleet size.
